subject: Fabio Cannavaro
title: Cannavaro: the CV and the 2006 wall

lines.vo: Six hundred and ninety World Cup minutes. Not one card. Fabio Cannavaro.
Five clean sheets. Two goals conceded. Then came the coaching CV.
Benevento: seventeen games, three wins, seven draws, seven defeats. Very balanced. Then the sack.
Dinamo Zagreb: fourteen games. Udinese: six, not kept. Seventeen, fourteen, six. A countdown.
He once told Ronaldo to keep playing a few more years. Right after Ronaldo scored twice against him. Fair enough, he had the evidence.
Only the third defender to win the Ballon d'Or, after Beckenbauer and Sammer.
Seventeen games at Benevento. Six hundred and ninety minutes without a card. Both are true. Only one is on the wall.
